test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

He said, “I will go and return quickly.”

options.text: He said that he would go and return quickly.
He said that he will gone and returned quickly.
He said that I would go and return quickly.
He said that he would go and I will return quickly.

solution:
The correct answer is **"He said that he would go and return quickly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting direct speech to reported speech, the tense of the verbs typically shift back.
 
 
• For example, **"will" **in direct speech often becomes **"would" **in reported speech.
 
 
 
• Pronouns also change to reflect the shift in perspective.
 
 
• **"I" **becomes **"he" or "she" **depending on the subject.
 
 
 
• The words **"that" **is often used in reported speech to introduce the reported clause.
 
• Option 1 correctly applies these changes without altering the meaning of the original sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 ("He said that he will gone and returned quickly.") is incorrect because "will gone and returned" is not grammatically correct.
 
 
• Also, the tense shift from "will" to "would" has not been correctly applied.
 
 
 
• Option 3 ("He said that I would go and return quickly.") incorrectly retains the first person pronoun "I" in the reported speech, which does not correctly reflect the shift from direct to reported speech.
 
• Option 4 ("He said that he would go and I will return quickly.") is incorrect because it mixes pronouns ("he" and "I") incorrectly and does not maintain a consistent backshift in verbs (uses "will" instead of "would" for the second verb).
